batch: C04b compact direct AC/noise frequency tables and resistor override repairs
qualification_delta: The publication adds explicit expected-value assertions for all authored coordinate columns to frequency_data.rs. That test is rerun natively and as optimized WASM. Production Rust source is unchanged after source_revision; hashes below identify the final tests and implementation.

implementation.coordinates: Authored table/column spelling, canonical frequency/parameter/device targets, and column values in original row order. Declared parameters win over identically named devices. Physical frequency stays on each solved point.
implementation.executor: One row loop for compact and legacy APIs, shared borrowed validation, fallible outer vector reservations, original model lifecycle and ordinary AC/noise solvers. Only legacy calls retain full row netlists.
implementation.limits: Point/run/coordinate admission precedes metadata allocation. Each row gets the caller replay policy and remaining result allowance; errors report the cumulative request and original limit. Legacy retained root source and typed scalar bindings use the aggregate expanded-source allowance.
implementation.termination: Failures/cancellation return no partial result. The compact result carries requested row count and a model-finish cause for a successful prefix. Driver tests cover finish after an accepted point, finish before the next point, no-data finish and independent later runs.
implementation.resistor_overrides: Unknown instance targets fail explicitly. Canonical aliases update the binding consumed by the solver, including M/MULT, TC/TC1 and NOISE/NOISY. Existing step regression coverage remains active.

independent_oracles: Selected-unit voltage noise referral = 4*k*T*R; output PSD = 4*k*T*R/(1+(2*pi*f*R*C)^2), k=1.380649e-23 under BestAvailable.
DC current-driven resistance gives V=I*R/M; temperature coefficient gives R=R0*(1+TC1*(T-TNOM)). Checks include the configured DC shunt conductance tolerance.
Setting the resistor NOISE alias to zero suppresses its spectrum despite an authored NOISY=1 binding.

commands.command: cargo test --locked -p rspice-core --lib -- engine::data engine::ac::tests::ac_data netlist::data_table engine::noise::tests::noise_data

cargo test --locked -p rspice-core --test frequency_data --test frequency_data_zero --test resistor_override_admission --test control_dc --test control_noise --test control_execution --test noise_input_reference
cargo clippy --locked -p rspice-core -p rspice-cli -p rspice-wasm --lib --bins -- -D warnings

cargo test --locked -p rspice-core --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --no-default-features --features wasm,veriloga-wasm-jit --test frequency_data --test resistor_override_admission -- --nocapture
cargo test --locked -p rspice-core --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --no-default-features --features wasm,veriloga-wasm-jit --test frequency_data -- --nocapture

remaining: All 15 work packages remain unfinished. Control implementation count stays 5 of 29; AcData/NoiseData are not yet control-host implementations.
Add table control dispatch, presentation, full-coordinate grid matching, immutable dataset ordinal behavior and direct/control equivalence.
Resolve row options against already-resolved caller settings and source-ordered runtime option precedence.
Fix TEMP/TNOM expression prescanning, preserving scope/conditionals/redefinition/seeded evaluation and temperature scalar synchronization.
Migrate typed documents and CLI/WASM adapters to the compact results; preserve per-row expression/projection context and define a valid noise-integration policy.
Whole-heap/AST storage, inner-loop cancellation latency and performance qualification remain C13 work; numeric and retained root-source budgets are not whole-process memory bounds.
Frequency-grid allocator-cause propagation remains open. Row-vector allocator errors are typed here.

open_reproducer.cause: Temperature prescan runs before authored parameter declarations are collected.
open_reproducer.qualification_boundary: The passing table-temperature oracle uses literal .options temp=27 and TEMP table overrides, not a parameter expression in .OPTIONS.

scope_limits: WASM tests exercise public native-device core paths. Enabling the veriloga-wasm-jit feature is not evidence of executing a JIT model.
No CLI/WASM adapter migration or adapter runtime qualification is claimed by this slice; strict Clippy checks their build integration.
No product certification, complete simulator parity or production-readiness claim.
